notes: After round 1 (best test success 0.90 at 15/4/40/0.5/0.5; 0.88 at three others). The 0.88-0.90 designs all had 12-18 mm width, 35-45 mm length and TPU 0.4-0.7; the lower scorers were wide (20-22 mm, which spends print time on plastic), long (50-55 mm, which lowers the breaking force) or low-TPU (0.2). Round 2 pushes towards more TPU (friction) and shorter, narrower fingers to stay under the print-time cap, and varies V depth.
